test_DisjointLinearBandit_learn_batch: test the DisjointLinearBandit learn_batch method to verify linear regression converges on reward predictions
test_DisjointLinearBandit_ucb_act: test the DisjointLinearBandit act method with UCB exploration to select highest-reward actions
test_DisjointLinearBandit_thompson_sampl: test the DisjointLinearBandit act method with Thompson sampling exploration for stochastic action selection
test_DisjointLinearBandit_action_vector: test the DisjointLinearBandit act method with discrete action vectors of arbitrary dimension
test_DisjointLinearBandit_torchscript_tr: test that a traced DisjointLinearBandit policy learner produces identical results to the original model
